upstream.description: Shodan Eye This tool collects all the information about all devices directly connected to the internet using the specified keywords that you enter. Author: Jolanda de Koff

classification.analysis: Shodan Eye is an OSINT/reconnaissance CLI tool that aggregates device discovery and vulnerability information from the Shodan search engine. Collects metadata about internet-connected devices (webcams, routers, servers, industrial equipment) using user-specified search queries and optional API authentication. Designed for network security audits, vulnerability research, and IoT device discovery; tested on Kali Linux, Parrot OS, BlackArch, Termux, and Windows.

use_cases.title: Audit internet-facing devices connected to your organization's network
Research vulnerabilities in exposed industrial and IoT equipment
Gather device metadata and service banners for penetration testing
Discover misconfigured servers and endpoints exposed to the internet
Perform ethical hacking assessments on home or corporate network perimeter
